objectives:
By the end of this course, students will be able to:
1.	Apply logical reasoning and proof techniques to solve mathematical problems.
2.	Understand and manipulate sets, relations, and functions.
3.	Solve counting and combinatorial problems using discrete methods.
4.	Analyze sequences and solve recursive problems.
5.	Understand graph theory concepts and apply them to real-world problems.
6.	Develop basic algorithmic thinking for discrete structures.
content: This course introduces the fundamental concepts of discrete mathematics with an emphasis on graph theory and its applications in computer science and engineering. Topics include logic, set theory, combinatorics, functions, relations, recursion, graph theory, and algorithmic applications. The course emphasizes problem-solving, mathematical reasoning, and modeling discrete structures.
